narr: A surface boundary sagged southward during the afternoon of July 29th and served as a catalyst for development of isolated strong to severe storms through July 30th across portions of North Georgia, including the Atlanta metro. These storms produced isolated reports of trees down causing structural damage and flash flooding.
ev: Law enforcement reported standing water in downtown Cave Spring due to heavy rainfall producing a rise on nearby Cedar Creek and slow drainage. Radar estimates indicate that between 1.5 and 2 inches of rain fell quickly on top of 1 to 2.5 inches that occurred in the preceding 24-hours.
lsr: STANDING WATER IN DOWNTOWN CAVE SPRING.
